newsitem.title: TURKEY: Key Turk right party to support govt in censure.
newsitem.headline: Key Turk right party to support govt in censure.

text.p: A Turkish far-right Islamist party has pledged the support of its seven deputies to the government in a censure motion on Tuesday in a decision that could swing the tight vote in favour of the Islamist-led alliance.

The Anatolian news agency said Grand Unity Party (BBP) leader Muhsin Yazicioglu had announced that his MPs would vote against the motion in a preliminary vote on Tuesday, bolstering the government's slim majority in parliament.
The government has 280 seats in the 550-seat house but the opposition parties, who filed the censure motion, say they have the support of several MPs from the Islamist-conservative ruling coalition.
The opposition motion, which is in effect a no-confidence motion against the government, criticises Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's alliance for moving away from the country's secular tradition.
Islamist leader Erbakan's government has survived three censure motions in its 11-month lifetime.
If parliament votes on Tuesday to go ahead with the motion, it will hold a final vote on Saturday. According to Turkish parliamentary tradition the government would resign if it loses Tuesday's vote.
